title: 'travel to a known place' only lists visited landmarks, not every room passed through (e.g. Split Oak, Charcoal Ring, and most Iron Downs rooms never appear even after being visited), which is explained once up front but easy to forget mid-game when a shortcut you expect isn't offered.
